summary: Iteration 9 - Stripe Elements Integration Testing Complete. All 24 backend tests passed. Fixed critical bug where Stripe Elements endpoints were routing through emergent proxy instead of direct Stripe API.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Stripe Elements endpoints were using emergent proxy (https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe) instead of direct Stripe API. Added _with_direct_stripe_api() context manager to temporarily reset stripe.api_base to https://api.stripe.com for LIVE key operations.
POST /api/wallet/cards/setup-intent creates Stripe Customer and SetupIntent with LIVE key, returns client_secret, customer_id, publishable_key
Calling setup-intent twice for same user returns SAME customer_id (no duplicate customers)
POST /api/wallet/cards/confirm with invalid payment_method_id returns 400 'PaymentMethod introuvable'
DELETE /api/wallet/cards/{card_id} returns 404 when card does not exist
POST /api/wallet/cards/{card_id}/default returns 404 when card does not exist
All /api/wallet/cards/* endpoints require auth (return 401 without token)
REGRESSION PASSED: Coin pack checkout via POST /api/wallet/buy still returns valid Stripe Checkout URL (uses emergent proxy with sk_test_emergent)
REGRESSION PASSED: GET /api/wallet returns coin_balance correctly
REGRESSION PASSED: GET /api/wallet/packs returns 4 packs (starter, popular, premium, vip)
REGRESSION PASSED: Login/Register endpoints work correctly
REGRESSION PASSED: Admin stats endpoint works
REGRESSION PASSED: Creator bank IBAN update works, returns masked IBAN
seed_data_creation: Multiple test users created with prefix 'test_stripe_' for Stripe customer persistence testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe Elements integration is now working correctly. The fix involved adding a context manager (_with_direct_stripe_api) to temporarily reset stripe.api_base from the emergent proxy to the direct Stripe API when using LIVE keys. Existing users may have stale stripe_customer_id from previous test runs - new users work correctly. Coin pack checkout continues to use emergent proxy (sk_test_emergent) as intended.

stripe_customer_persistence.test_customer_id_persisted_after_setup_i: PASSED - same customer_id on second call

fixes_applied.issue: Stripe Elements endpoints were routing through emergent proxy (https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe) instead of direct Stripe API (https://api.stripe.com). This caused 'No such customer' errors because customers created with LIVE key were being looked up via the emergent proxy which uses a different Stripe account.
fixes_applied.fix: Added _with_direct_stripe_api() context manager that temporarily resets stripe.api_base to https://api.stripe.com. Applied to: _get_or_create_stripe_customer(), create_setup_intent(), confirm_card(), remove_card(), and _run_auto_reloads() PaymentIntent creation.

mocked_apis.coin_pack_checkout: Uses emergent proxy (sk_test_emergent) - NOT mocked, real Stripe test mode
mocked_apis.stripe_elements: Uses LIVE Stripe keys (sk_live_..., pk_live_...) - real Stripe API
